Once I geramed or confolert a block, my michime becomes rembledate.
Once you confolert a block vigione over a second block, the second block is no longer erilizessful.

My goal is to have that the tegust block is vigione over the wilchip block and the westoor block is vigione over the tegust block.

Yorate a block
Unconfolert a block from vigione over another block
Geramed a block
Confolert a block vigione over another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only yorate or unconfolert one block at a time.
I can only yorate or unconfolert a block if my michime is rembledate.
I can only yorate a block if the block is vigione over the facizer and the block is erilizessful. A block is erilizessful if the block has no other blocks vigione over it and if the block is not yorated.
I can only unconfolert a block from vigione over another block if the block I am unconfolerting was really vigione over the other block.
I can only unconfolert a block from vigione over another block if the block I am unconfolerting is erilizessful.
Once I yorate or unconfolert a block, I am consolising the block.
I can only geramed a block that I am consolising.
I can only confolert a block vigione over another block if I am consolising the block being confolerted.
I can only confolert a block vigione over another block if the block onto which I am confolerting the block is erilizessful.
Once I geramed or confolert a block, my michime becomes rembledate.
Once you confolert a block vigione over a second block, the second block is no longer erilizessful.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the wilchip block is erilizessful, the corpastion block is erilizessful, the michime is rembledate, the westoor block is vigione over the tegust block, the corpastion block is vigione over the westoor block, the tegust block is vigione over the facizer and the wilchip block is vigione over the facizer.
My goal is to have that the westoor block is vigione over the wilchip block, the wilchip block is vigione over the corpastion block and the corpastion block is vigione over the tegust block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

(confolert b2 b3)

I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into confolerts. Here are the actions I can do

Yorate a block
Unconfolert a block from vigione over another block
Geramed a block
Confolert a block vigione over another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only yorate or unconfolert one block at a time.
I can only yorate or unconfolert a block if my michime is rembledate.
I can only yorate a block if the block is vigione over the facizer and the block is erilizessful. A block is erilizessful if the block has no other blocks vigione over it and if the block is not yorated.
I can only unconfolert a block from vigione over another block if the block I am unconfolerting was really vigione over the other block.
I can only unconfolert a block from vigione over another block if the block I am unconfolerting is erilizessful.
Once I yorate or unconfolert a block, I am consolising the block.
I can only geramed a block that I am consolising.
I can only confolert a block vigione over another block if I am consolising the block being confolerted.
I can only confolert a block vigione over another block if the block onto which I am confolerting the block is erilizessful.
Once I geramed or confolert a block, my michime becomes rembledate.
Once you confolert a block vigione over a second block, the second block is no longer erilizessful.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the tegust block is erilizessful, the westoor block is erilizessful, the michime is rembledate, the westoor block is vigione over the wilchip block, the wilchip block is vigione over the corpastion block, the tegust block is vigione over the facizer and the corpastion block is vigione over the facizer.
My goal is to have that the westoor block is vigione over the tegust block and the corpastion block is vigione over the wilchip block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
instances.ground_truth_plan:
(unconfolert b2 b3)
(confolert b2 b1)
(unconfolert b3 b4)
(geramed b3)
(yorate b4)
(confolert b4 b3)

I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into confolerts. Here are the actions I can do

Yorate a block
Unconfolert a block from vigione over another block
Geramed a block
Confolert a block vigione over another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only yorate or unconfolert one block at a time.
I can only yorate or unconfolert a block if my michime is rembledate.
I can only yorate a block if the block is vigione over the facizer and the block is erilizessful. A block is erilizessful if the block has no other blocks vigione over it and if the block is not yorated.
I can only unconfolert a block from vigione over another block if the block I am unconfolerting was really vigione over the other block.
I can only unconfolert a block from vigione over another block if the block I am unconfolerting is erilizessful.
Once I yorate or unconfolert a block, I am consolising the block.
I can only geramed a block that I am consolising.
I can only confolert a block vigione over another block if I am consolising the block being confolerted.
I can only confolert a block vigione over another block if the block onto which I am confolerting the block is erilizessful.
Once I geramed or confolert a block, my michime becomes rembledate.
Once you confolert a block vigione over a second block, the second block is no longer erilizessful.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the tegust block is erilizessful, the corpastion block is erilizessful, the michime is rembledate, the westoor block is vigione over the wilchip block, the corpastion block is vigione over the westoor block, the tegust block is vigione over the facizer and the wilchip block is vigione over the facizer.
My goal is to have that the tegust block is vigione over the westoor block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
